component: OpenPGP address parser and expression style

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: stripEmail delegates to parseEmails with decoded input, then maps address objects to email and joins with commas. This replaced incomplete regular expressions that failed on quoted display names and bracket/comment combinations. parseEmails uses nsIMsgHeaderParser for encoded or decoded input and returns an empty array when parsing throws; callers must not assume the old bracket error will still throw. A short map/join pipeline expresses these three simple steps clearly. This is a scoped example, not a ban on loops or reduce elsewhere.
title: Use the shared message header parser for OpenPGP address lists
